task.task_id: string — unique UUID for this task
task.sender_agent_id: string — agent_id of the sending agent
task.receiver_agent_id: string — agent_id of the receiving agent
task.payload: object — input data matching receiver agent input_schema
task.result: object — output data matching receiver agent output_schema or null if pending
task.error: string — error message if status is failed or null
